partner_result.application: Applied its affine-uniform fixed four-coordinate bound C4/sigma after compressing a pure leakage bank V to W=a^T V and rescaling W to a cap-one variable.

new_results.statement: For cap-one f, K_f(u,xi)=Fourier_v[(1/2)f((v+u)/2)f((v-u)/2)] obeys integral integral |K_f|^p <= pi for every p>=2, with exact quadratic decoupling |phi_Q(t)|^2=integral product_j K_j(u_j,t(Au)_j)du and translation covariance by a pure phase.

For A=[[B,k a^T,C],[a k^T,0,a b^T],[C^T,b a^T,D]], Bk=0, ||k||=1, one eigenvalue of B >=nu in modulus, L=||a||2>0, arbitrary cap-one independent inputs satisfy ||p_Q||inf <=1000(8+log4) max(1/nu,sqrt(2)/L).

stress_test: B=diag(1,epsilon,0), 0<epsilon<1, a_N=(1/sqrt(N),...,1/sqrt(N)) has nonzero spectrum {1,epsilon,1,-1}; single leakage coordinates vanish as N^-1/2 while the collective theorem remains uniform.
external_input: Sharp one-dimensional product-projection density bound sqrt(2): Rogozin + Ball / Rudelson-Vershynin Theorem 1.2.
unresolved_implication: Extend collective aggregation beyond a zero-self-curvature one-direction leakage bank. Candidate next step: a coupled Brascamp-Lieb/transversality estimate for the unnormalized kernels along xi_j=t(Au)_j, preserving overlap masses before reciprocal inversion.
